Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
mad...@rocketmail.com wrote:
> Can you have more than 1 in play at a time?

Yes.

> And if so, can you take 1 from
> EACH every master phase you do not use a master card?

The updated (V:TES) card text should clear this up:
"You may use a master phase action to move 1 blood from this card to
your blood pool."

It takes a Master Phase Action, not just an abstinence from playing cards.
If you have more than one Master Phase Action (from Anson, Rumors, or
Parthenon), you can take a pool from more than one (or more than one pool
from a given) investment. Otherwise (the usual case), you can take only
one pool from one investment.
